bugs.name: Out-of-range repository settings page falsely claims the account owns no repositories
bugs.summary: Requesting an out-of-range page in repository settings displays `You do not own any repositories` even though the account owns repositories.
bugs.expected: Out-of-range pagination should not claim that an account with repositories owns none.
bugs.actual: Requesting an out-of-range page in repository settings displays `You do not own any repositories` even though the account owns repositories.
reproSteps: Open the authenticated account's repository settings and confirm that owned repositories are listed.
Open the same repository settings route with an out-of-range page such as `?page=999`.
Observe that the page falsely says `You do not own any repositories` instead of indicating that the requested page has no results.

bugs.name: Follower card content does not scale to mobile grid columns
bugs.summary: At mobile width, follower cards retain content sizing and secondary fields that do not fit their grid columns, fragmenting display names and URLs.
bugs.expected: Adapt avatar/icon sizing, typography or displayed fields to the available mobile card width so follower identity remains readable. A three-column grid is acceptable; compact content, deliberate truncation or omitting secondary fields can satisfy this without making each card fill the row.
bugs.actual: In the recorded 390×844 view, the follower card occupies roughly 120px while its avatar and text consume most of that width. The display name Eval Profile Sample 2026 splits within words, including Eva / l, and the website wraps into many short fragments. The supplied review screenshot shows the same mismatch between narrow columns and the retained avatar, type and metadata content.
reproSteps: Use the supplied authenticated eval session and set the viewport to 390 by 844 CSS pixels. Precondition: eval follows target profile mo-followerslist-4827639 and has display name Eval Profile Sample 2026 plus a website URL.
Open the target profile at /mo-followerslist-4827639 and click its visible 1 Followers count.

Inspect the follower card’s avatar, display name and website. Observe that the retained content sizing and fields leave too little room for the name beside the avatar, splitting it within words, while the URL wraps into many short lines.

Assess whether the content remains readable within the mobile column. The reported defect is the content scaling and prioritization; retaining three columns or unused slots when only one follower exists is acceptable.

bugs.name: Profile editor cannot clear Full Name
bugs.summary: Submitting an empty Full Name reports success but leaves the previous name saved; it remains populated after refresh.
bugs.expected: After submitting the profile form with Full Name empty, the optional field should remain empty and the cleared value should persist after refresh.
bugs.actual: The form displayed “Your profile has been updated,” but Full Name still showed “mo-gitea-05-account-profile-temp.” Refreshing the profile page showed the same saved value.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval.
Open the eval account menu, choose Settings, and open Profile at /user/settings. The Full Name field was already populated with the disposable value rather than blank.
Set Full Name to mo-gitea-05-account-profile-temp and click Update Profile; the page reports that the profile has been updated.
Clear Full Name and click Update Profile again.
Observe the success message while the Full Name field still contains mo-gitea-05-account-profile-temp. Refresh /user/settings and verify the value remains populated.

bugs.name: Blocking a nonexistent username returns HTTP 500
bugs.summary: Submitting a unique username that does not exist on the Blocked users page opens a 500 error page.
bugs.expected: The form should reject an unknown user with a validation message.
bugs.actual: Submitting a unique username that does not exist on the Blocked users page opens a 500 error page.
reproSteps: Open User Settings → Blocked users.
Enter a unique nonexistent username and click Block.
Observe the 500 Internal Server Error page.

bugs.name: Zero-followers profile tab has no empty state
bugs.summary: The 0 Followers link opens a blank content area with no explanation or empty-state text.
bugs.expected: The Followers tab should explain that the account has no followers.
bugs.actual: The 0 Followers link opens a blank content area with no explanation or empty-state text.
reproSteps: Open the eval profile and click 0 Followers.
Observe the empty content area at ?tab=followers.

bugs.name: Public Profile description uses incorrect grammar
bugs.summary: The profile settings introduction says “Control how your profile is show to other users.”
bugs.expected: The sentence should say “shown to other users.”
bugs.actual: The profile settings introduction says “Control how your profile is show to other users.”
reproSteps: Open User Settings → Profile.
Read the Public Profile introductory sentence.

bugs.name: Alex's followers list still shows admin after admin unfollows Alex and the follower count returns to zero
bugs.summary: On Alex’s Followers page, the sidebar updated to 0 followers and Follow after the admin unfollowed, but the admin’s follower card remained visible. This persisted through repeated attempts and waits.
bugs.expected: After the signed-in admin unfollows Alex, Alex’s Followers list should no longer include the admin, consistent with the sidebar showing 0 followers.
bugs.actual: After Unfollow completed, the sidebar showed 0 Followers and the button changed to Follow, but the Explore Admin follower card remained in the visible Followers list. The mismatch persisted for at least six seconds and was reproduced again.
reproSteps: Use the signed-in admin account by loading the supplied saved admin session; no credentials were entered. Navigate to /alex.
Confirm Alex’s profile starts at 0 Followers and 0 Following, with Follow and Block user controls; the admin is not following or blocking Alex.
Click Follow and wait for the sidebar to show 1 Followers and Unfollow.
Click the 1 Followers link. On /alex?tab=followers, confirm the Explore Admin / Profile Check 20261009 card appears.
While the Followers list is open, click Unfollow.

Observe the sidebar show 0 Followers and Follow while the Explore Admin follower card remains visible; wait at least six seconds to confirm it persists. The same result occurred on a repeated attempt.

bugs.name: Mobile avatar file input is clipped
bugs.summary: At a 320px width, the avatar file input extends past the settings card and is clipped by the viewport.
bugs.expected: At a 320×700 viewport, the avatar file chooser should fit within the Avatar card without its control border extending beyond the viewport. Filename truncation within a correctly sized control is acceptable.
bugs.actual: On /user/settings, the file chooser’s outlined field continues past the Avatar card’s right edge and reaches the viewport edge, where it is clipped. The clipping remained visible after waiting five seconds.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 320×700 CSS pixels and sign in with the authorized fixture account.
Choose Settings from the account menu to open /user/settings.
Scroll to the Avatar card and inspect the Choose new avatar file chooser.
Observe that its outlined field extends beyond the card and is clipped at the viewport’s right edge; wait for the layout to settle and confirm the overflow remains.

bugs.name: Profile edits are cleared after invalid Website URL submission
bugs.summary: Submitting a profile with an unsupported Website URL displays a validation error but re-renders the profile form with previously saved values, discarding unsaved Full Name, Biography, Website, and Location edits.
bugs.expected: Reject the Website URL while retaining all submitted profile values in the form so the user can correct the URL without losing other edits.
bugs.actual: With Website set to ftp://example.com/profile and distinct unsaved values in Full Name, Biography and Location, Update Profile displays `form.Website "Url" is not a valid URL.` and all four fields immediately revert to their previously saved values without a manual reload, discarding the submitted draft. In the recorded fixture the previously saved values were blank.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Settings > Profile. Record the currently saved Full Name, Biography, Website and Location values.
Enter distinct new draft values in Full Name, Biography and Location; enter ftp://example.com/profile as Website.
Click Update Profile. Observe the Website URL validation error.
Inspect the four fields immediately without refreshing: they contain their previously saved values, losing the submitted draft. Correcting the Website URL now requires re-entering the other edits.

matchingGuidance.scope: Unsaved submitted draft input is lost after recoverable validation. Already saved profile values are not erased.
